title: Indian National AI Olympiad (INAIO) 2027
copy: National AI olympiad organized with ACM India & iKDD leading to Team India at INAIO 2027 in Singapore. Stage 1 OMR exam takes place December 13, 2026.
checklist: Confirm whether your school is registered as an authorized examination centre (by Nov 22, 2026).
Enroll online at manageexam.com/INAIOStudents, upload documents, and pay ₹300 + GST by Nov 22, 2026.
Review curriculum and sample problem sets ahead of the Dec 13, 2026 Stage 1 OMR exam.

title: NASA STEM Gateway Virtual Events
copy: Free virtual NASA sessions & challenges. Surprisingly STEM (Dec 3; reg by Nov 25/30) and Dream with Us Design Challenge (by Dec 8) are open internationally; Internships Webinar & Goddard CTE Day (by Dec 2) are US-citizen only.
checklist: Filter by Activity Format: Virtual and Citizenship Requirements: None for international-open events.
Register by Nov 25 (11:59 PM ET) / Nov 30 for Surprisingly STEM: Electronics Technicians (Dec 3).
Check Dream with Us Design Challenge (Grades 6–12, closes Dec 8, 2026) and create a NASA Gateway account.

title: Carpe Diem MUN (C.D MUN 2026)
copy: Delegate applications for C.D MUN 2026: Days 1–2 online committee sessions (Dec 18–19) and an in-person Day 3 Grand Finale in Hyderabad (Dec 20) for Grades 9–12 across 7 committees.
checklist: Register individually on Gavelling by Nov 29, 2026 (₹500 per delegate).
Select Hybrid track (Grades 9–12 for in-person Hyderabad finale) or Online track (UG years 1–4).
Choose from DISEC, Global AI Governance Summit, JCC 1/2, Lok Sabha, UN Women, or UNHRC.

title: Zonal Computing Olympiad (ZCO-2027)
copy: First round of the Indian Computing Olympiad (IARCS & CodeChef). Online registration closes at 9:00 PM IST on Dec 1 for the Dec 12, 2026 programming test (C, C++, Java, Python).
checklist: Complete online registration and pay ₹472 (₹400 + GST) before Dec 1, 2026 at 9:00 PM IST.
Download your Admit Card (~5 days before) and verify your city centre for Dec 12 (2:00–5:00 PM).
Practice on ICO Online Study Material and CodeChef ZCO archives ahead of INOI-2027 (Feb 6, 2027).

title: Scholastic Art & Writing Awards 2027
copy: Prestigious creative arts & writing awards across 20+ categories with regional deadlines starting Dec 1, 2026 ($15/entry with fee waivers). Verify US/Canada/at-large residency rules before submitting.
checklist: Check official Region Locator and 2027 eligibility rules (U.S., U.S. territories/bases, or Canada).
Create an account at portal.artandwriting.org, link your educator, and obtain guardian consent.
Upload entries and submit fee ($15/entry) or fee waiver before your regional cutoff.

title: Univario International MUN 2026
copy: Beginner-friendly online MUN offering 5 committees in both English and Hindi with 100 expected delegates on Dec 11–13, 2026.
checklist: Apply on mymun before Dec 5 (Chairs) or Dec 10, 2026 (Delegates & Head Delegates).
Choose your preferred English or Hindi committee track.
Prepare country stance and resolution drafts before the Dec 11–13 conference.

title: Research Science Initiative India (RSI-India)
copy: Free 6-week mentored summer research program (June 6–July 17, 2027) at IISc Bengaluru by CEE. Includes coursework, individual research mentorship, paper, talk, and free room & board.
checklist: Apply individually on CEE SlideRoom by Dec 14, 2026 (no school nomination required).
Prepare personal statements, STEM achievements, school transcripts, and teacher recommendations.
Confirm Class 10 completion and Indian citizenship; plan for travel & medical insurance if selected.

title: DLMUN Climate Summit VII
copy: Free online climate-focused MUN (Dec 18–20, 2026) with 4 beginner committees; conference policy resources are shared with UNEA, UNFCCC, and ECOSOC.
checklist: Apply on mymun by Dec 18, 2026 (Delegate, Head Delegate, Observer, or Faculty Advisor).
Prepare climate policy positions for the Dec 19–20 committee sessions.
Top delegates may be invited to future DLMUN chairing or secretariat roles.

title: Hyderabad & Online Hackathons Hub
copy: Curated Hyderabad & online hackathons: Build Your Bharat at IIT Hyderabad (until Nov 21), HackWithAditya / CMR Hackfest 4.0 (Nov 25), Arbiter Hacks V1 (until Dec 20), and Hack with Hyderabad 4.0 (starts Dec 18).
checklist: Check immediate deadlines: Build Your Bharat at IIT-H (Nov 21) and CMR Hackfest 4.0 (Nov 25).
Monitor Hack with Hyderabad 4.0 (starts Dec 18, 10 AM IST) for venue and registration link.
Verify team size (usually 1–5) and school-age eligibility rules on each hackathon's official page.

title: HRZMUN 2026 (Horizon MUN)
copy: Free online Model UN conference (Dec 26–27, 2026) welcoming 300 delegates across 8 UN committees (including 6 beginner committees) in English.
checklist: Submit your Delegate, Chair, or Observer application on mymun by Dec 24, 2026.
Choose from UNESCO, UNICEF, UNSC, UNDP, UNEP, WHO, UNHRC, or FAO.
Prepare your country research in English for the Dec 26–27 sessions.

title: Open Relations & Engagement MUN
copy: Free online MUN conference (Jan 9–10, 2027) expecting 300 delegates across 9 committees (8 beginner-friendly) including UNGA, UNICEF, UNSC, UNESCO, and WHO.
checklist: Apply as a Delegate on mymun before Jan 3, 2027 (Chair applications closed Nov 15).
Select your preferred committee among the 9 UN councils.
Join the conference's delegate group and prepare opening speeches for Jan 9–10, 2027.

title: The Conrad Challenge 2026–2027
copy: Global innovation challenge across Aerospace, Cyber-Tech, Energy/Environment, Health, and Water. Phase 2 Innovation Stage closes Jan 7, 2027 (financial aid closes Dec 3, 2026; $499/team).
checklist: Note: Phase 1 Activation closed Oct 30, 2026; advancing teams complete Phase 2 deliverables.
Apply for Innovation Stage fee financial aid by Dec 3, 2026 (11:59 PM CST) if needed.
Submit Investor Pitch, team video, Business Plan, and $499 team fee by Jan 7, 2027.

title: IIT Madras School Connect
copy: 8-week university-level introductory certificate courses offered by IIT Madras CODE for Classes 9–12 through partner schools. Jan 2027 batch closes Jan 8, 2027.
checklist: Verify with your school whether it is registered as an IIT Madras School Connect partner.
Register for the Jan 2027 batch before Jan 8, 2027 (next batch opens April 2027).
Complete weekly assignments and exams to earn the IIT Madras CODE e-certificate.

title: Diamond Challenge 2027
copy: Global entrepreneurship competition by University of Delaware Horn Entrepreneurship with a $100K prize pool for business and social venture concepts. Written concept & pitch due Jan 14, 2027.
checklist: Form a high school team and choose either Business Innovation or Social Innovation track.
Download the Curriculum Roadmap and confirm exact round dates inside Competitors' Login.
Prepare and submit your written concept and video pitch by Jan 14, 2027.

title: Biomimicry Youth Design Challenge
copy: Free nature-inspired engineering design challenge for teams of 2–8 students with an adult coach (18+). Design biological solutions aligned with UN SDGs; confirm 2027 cycle dates on host portal.
checklist: Form a team of 2–8 students (Grades 6–12) with a school teacher or adult coach (18+).
Verify the upcoming 2027 cycle registration window (historically closes late January).
Prepare a written and visual portfolio proposing a nature-inspired engineering solution.

title: NSS Space Settlement Contest 2027
copy: Design a permanent orbital free-space settlement through engineering models, research, or artwork. Entries due Feb 15, 2027 ($15 fee with hardship waivers; $5,000 top scholarship prize).
checklist: Prepare an original free-space (orbital, non-planetary) settlement design PDF (<=50 pages).
Strictly cite any AI-generated graphics; AI-generated text is prohibited for Literary Merit.
Submit via AwardForce portal (opens December) with $15 fee or hardship waiver by Feb 15, 2027.

title: Blue Ocean Competition 2027
copy: Free global virtual entrepreneurship competition where high schoolers (solo or teams up to 5) pitch a new-market business concept in a 5-minute video by Feb 21, 2027.
checklist: Register solo or in a team of up to 5 students (across schools allowed) using a personal email.
Complete the free Blue Ocean Mini-Course and follow the official pitch scoring rubric.
Upload your 5-minute YouTube pitch + video file before Feb 21, 2027 (midnight local time).

title: Ashoka Young Scholars Programme (YSP)
copy: Ashoka University's pre-college summer programme for students entering Grades 9–12 in May/June 2027. Applications open Dec 1, 2026 (₹1,000 fee); merit-cum-need aid up to 100% due Mar 14, 2027.
checklist: Start your YSP application when the portal opens on Dec 1, 2026 (₹1,000 application fee).
Complete the merit-cum-need scholarship section by Mar 14, 2027 with a 250-word essay & income docs.
Verify full programme fees, session dates, and residential format on Ashoka's official YSP page.

title: Build something with us
copy: Help research opportunities, write clear guides, create content or make NextStep a more useful place for students.

title: ISRO YUVIKA (2027 Cycle Watch)
copy: Two-week residential Young Scientist Programme hosted across 9 ISRO/DoS centres including NRSC Hyderabad. 2026 cycle opened late February; note ISRO regular internships are UG/PG/PhD & NASA OSTEM is US-only.
checklist: Monitor isro.gov.in in late February 2027 for the YUVIKA-2027 notification (Class 9 students).
Expect a two-week residential programme in May across 9 ISRO centres including Hyderabad.
Note: NASA OSTEM internships require U.S. citizenship, and ISRO regular internships require UG/PG/PhD.

title: IEOM India 2026 Robo Competition
copy: Design, build, and program a working robot for live demonstration and a 5–10 minute presentation at the 6th IEOM India Conference (Nov 5–7, 2026 completed; watch for next cycle).
checklist: Note: 2026 conference ran Nov 5–7, 2026 at BESTIU/Bengaluru; check IEOM for the 2027 edition.
Prepare a 2–4 page Project Summary aligned with 'Smart Robotic Solutions for a Better World'.
Check participant registration fees for school teams on the next IEOM India conference portal.

title: Tata Capital Pankh Scholarship
copy: Scholarship support for eligible students. Review the latest academic, family-income and documentation criteria before applying.

title: Seva First Innovation Challenge
copy: Explore a challenge built around ideas and practical solutions to real-world problems. Confirm current categories and eligibility on the official page.

title: Birdspiracy AI Competition 2026
copy: Identify a real community problem and propose how AI could help in a short presentation. Check the organiser’s current rules before entering.

title: GITAM Innovation Challenge 2026
copy: A chance to present an early-stage idea with a team. Verify the current registration fee, track requirements and prize details before registering.

title: IEEE TEMSMET School Innovation Challenge
copy: Showcase a science or technology idea, model or prototype. Check event dates, fees and venue details on the organiser’s page.

title: Panini Linguistics Olympiad (PLO) 2026–2027
copy: National computational linguistics olympiad coordinated by IIIT Hyderabad's LTRC. Online registration closes Nov 20, 2026, with walk-in registration available Nov 29, 2026.

title: Indian Talent Olympiad (ITO)
copy: National individual online olympiad across Science, Maths, English, GK, and Computer tracks with Slot 1 on Dec 5, 2026 and Slot 2 on Jan 9, 2027.

title: SOF Olympiads (IMO, ISO, ICSO, ISSO)
copy: Science Olympiad Foundation school-administered exams: IMO (Nov 26 / Dec 10), ISO (Dec 3), and ICSO (Dec 17, 2026). Coordinate with your school coordinator to register.

title: HBCSE Science & Math Olympiads (NSEs / INOs / RMO)
copy: Official Indian national science and mathematics olympiad pathway (NSEs Nov 21–22, 2026; INOs Jan 30–31, 2027) leading to International Olympiads.

title: Unified Cyber Olympiad (UCO)
copy: Cyber, reasoning, and mental ability olympiad hosted by Hyderabad-based Unified Council. Exam takes place December 27, 2026.

title: Unified International English Olympiad (UIEO)
copy: International English language and comprehension olympiad organized by Hyderabad-based Unified Council. Exam scheduled for January 3, 2027.

title: Unified International Mathematics Olympiad (UIMO)
copy: Curriculum-aligned mathematics olympiad by Hyderabad-based Unified Council testing problem-solving and logical reasoning. Exam date: January 10, 2027.

title: NSTSE (National Level Science Talent Search Examination)
copy: Diagnostic science and mathematics talent exam by Unified Council with skill-wise feedback reports. School offline exam Dec 2, 2026; direct online Jan 24, 2027.

title: Frontier Diplomatic Summit 2026
copy: Online Indian Model UN conference for school and university delegates running December 5–6, 2026 via Gavelling.

title: Summit of Leaders MUN (SOLMUN 2026)
copy: Online Model United Nations conference for Indian school and university students held December 12–13, 2026.

title: Elysian International MUN
copy: Free beginner-friendly online international MUN conference on MyMUN. Apply by December 10, 2026 for sessions on December 16–19, 2026.

title: Horizon MUN
copy: Free online international MUN for delegates aged 14–25. Apply by December 24, 2026 for the December 25–26, 2026 conference.

title: Rise Beyond MUN
copy: Free beginner-friendly online MUN hosted on MyMUN. Delegate applications close December 22, 2026 for the December 26–28, 2026 sessions.

title: Aerotech Academy — Build a Space Station
copy: Global aerospace design contest with Discord-hosted workshops where students engineer and submit a space station concept by January 31, 2027.

title: NASA Citizen Science Projects (Cloudspotting on Mars)
copy: Collaborate directly with NASA scientists on real planetary and astrophysics datasets—like Cloudspotting on Mars—open year-round to Grades 6–12 globally.

title: Harvard International Review Academic Writing Contest
copy: International academic essay competition by the Harvard International Review for Junior (Grades 7–8) and Senior (Grades 9–12) divisions. Fall round closes Jan 2, 2027.

title: Technovation Girls (2027 Challenge)
eligibility: Up to age 18 (girls + 2027 co-ed track) · Online
copy: Global tech entrepreneurship program where student teams build an AI or mobile app solving a community problem. Register by Mar 11, 2027; project submissions due May 5, 2027.

title: CREST Olympiads 2026–27 (CEO, CSO, CMO, CRO, CCO, IGWO)
copy: International online olympiads across English, Science, Maths, Reasoning, Cyber, and Green Warrior tracks. Level 1 exams run Dec 1, 2026 – Jan 27, 2027 by subject.

title: SPOT 2026–27 (Vikram Sarabhai Science Foundation)
copy: Vikram Sarabhai Science Foundation's Science Promotion Orient Test (SPOT) for Classes 3–12 across KV, CBSE, and CISCE boards, open to school and individual entries.

title: CRUX Model United Nations (CRUXMUN 2026)
copy: Online Indian Model United Nations conference for school and college delegates with applications open for the December 12–13, 2026 sessions.

title: Proton Model United Nations Crisis Edition (PMUNCRISIS 2026)
copy: Free crisis-focused online Indian Model United Nations conference for school and college students running December 12–13, 2026.

title: NEXUS MUN (NM 2026)
copy: Free online Indian Model UN conference open to school and college delegates, taking place December 20–21, 2026.

title: Electronic Model United Nations 2027 (EMUN27)
copy: Free multi-week online Indian Model United Nations conference for school and college students running December 28, 2026 through January 10, 2027.

title: FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) India 2026–27 (BIOBUZZ)
copy: National robotics competition with a Hyderabad Regional Qualifier (Jan 8–10, 2027) leading to Pune Nationals. Leadership Award submissions due Dec 15, 2026.

title: Essay Competition on Viksit Bharat – Samarthya aur Sankalp
copy: National MyGov & Ministry of Defence essay competition inviting Indian school students and youth to write on Viksit Bharat – Samarthya aur Sankalp by December 31, 2026.

title: Painting Contest on Samarth Bharat - Viksit Bharat
copy: National MyGov & Ministry of Defence painting contest for Indian school students and youth celebrating Samarth Bharat - Viksit Bharat. Entries close December 31, 2026.

title: PEYJAL GATHA – National Water Stories & Ideas Challenge
copy: Ministry of Jal Shakti national challenge on MyGov inviting Classes 8–12 students across India to submit water conservation stories and practical water ideas by December 8, 2026.

title: Science Without Borders Challenge 2027
copy: International student art & ocean conservation contest by the Khaled bin Sultan Living Oceans Foundation for ages 11–19 (Grades 6–12). Free submissions due March 1, 2027.

title: APEMUN 2026 (Assembly For Peace, Excellence And Exchange)
copy: Free online Indian Model United Nations conference for school and college delegates with applications open for December 25–27, 2026.

title: RELMUN 2026 (Regional Engagement & Leadership MUN)
copy: Free online Indian Model United Nations conference focused on regional engagement and leadership, running December 26–27, 2026.

title: Libertas Youth Conclave 2027 (LYC'27)
copy: New Year online Indian Model UN & youth conclave for school and college students taking place January 1–2, 2027.

title: Codeavour 8.0 International (AI, Robotics & Coding)
copy: Global AI, robotics, and coding championship for school students with online tracks and in-person Indian regional and national rounds.

title: IEOx Essay Challenge 2026/27 (International Economics Olympiad)
eligibility: High school students under 20 (solo or team up to 3)
copy: Official International Economics Olympiad essay competition for high school students under 20 (solo or teams up to 3). Submissions close December 15, 2026.

title: The TED Summer School Competition (Immerse x TED-Ed)
copy: Global competition by Immerse Education and TED-Ed inviting students aged 13–18 to pitch an idea worth spreading for scholarships by January 16, 2027.

title: Resolve MUN 2.0
copy: In-person Hyderabad Model United Nations conference hosted at Northfield International School on December 26–27, 2026 with open delegate registrations.

title: Hope International Youth Conference (HIYOC 2027)
copy: In-person Hyderabad international youth MUN and diplomacy conference scheduled for January 6–7, 2027, with applications open on MyMUN.

title: Blue Planet Awareness Contest 2027 (Bow Seat)
copy: Free global creative arts and environmental advocacy contest by Bow Seat for ages 11–18 across Junior and Senior divisions. Entries due June 7, 2027.

title: Eat Right Photography Contest 2026 (FSSAI / MyGov)
copy: National photography competition by FSSAI on MyGov inviting Indian students and youth to capture safe, healthy, and sustainable food stories by December 18, 2026.

title: Jago Grahak Jago Reel Making Challenge 2026 (MyGov)
copy: National MyGov consumer-awareness short-video reel challenge for Indian youth and students. Submissions close December 6, 2026.

title: The Junior Academy – Spring 2027 (NYAS)
eligibility: High school students (Spring invited / Apr general)
copy: New York Academy of Sciences virtual STEM innovation community for high schoolers. Spring 2027 invited cohort closes Jan 6, 2027; general applications open April 2027.
